notes.title: We are leaving Early Access! 11-20
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Today’s the day! Pogo Rogue is finally leaving early access! This update includes:


 8 new passive items
 4 new weapons
 2 brand new bosses


We really hope that you enjoy the new content! With this new release, we’re sure there’s one question: What’s next?

First of all, there are a few small things that we weren’t quite able to get done before today (bad week to get covid!). In particular, you can expect a few minor updates in the coming days: new music for the bosses, some new art, and a few other small things. We will also continue to seek out any new bugs or issues that need to be fixed! If you run into any bugs, please let us know!

Other than that, there is no roadmap for Pogo Rogue.
Does that mean there will be no updates to the game? 
Not necessarily! You might still see the occasional update: a bug fix, new art, or maybe even a little extra content. However, simply put, Pogo Rogue is a completely free student game, and most of the team has had to move on. The result is that we’re unable to prioritize development on this project.

Second, follow us on social media! 
If you’ve enjoyed Pogo Rogue make sure to follow us on YouTube, X, Instagram, or Discord! That way if we do make any big updates, you’ll be the first to know! Additionally, with many of our team members moving on to new projects in some capacity, we’ll make sure to promote any content they have made. So, if you enjoyed playing Pogo Rogue, there will be a decent chance you’ll enjoy their games as well!

Lastly, please share this game with your friends!
We’ve been blown away by your incredible support during the early access of this game. If we could ask for just one more thing, we’d greatly appreciate any support you can give in sharing Pogo Rogue! With the game being free, we are unable to do traditional marketing or participate in Steam Sale events. As such, every little bit of help you can give makes a huge difference!

We just want to reiterate how grateful we are to you for this experience. We are very proud of Pogo Rogue and are happy to see you all enjoying it! We are also grateful for your patience as we’ve had to adjust this release date over the past several months. We hope that you’ll continue to have fun bouncing to the top in Pogo Rogue!

Bounce Back Games

notes.title: Balance changes 10-12
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for bearing with us as we work through some minor balance issues. Our time for external playtesting was quite limited given the circumstances of our development, so we may have accidentally increased the difficulty a bit too much because our developers are too good at the game ;) As a result, we have made the following changes:


 Removed bats from area 1
 Increased starting health for starting character (Rogo), 3D, and Dogo.
 Minor nerfs to shield enemy, car enemy, bats, and blue Constructus bricks 
 Added more platforms and other small adjustments to area 1's level layouts
 Minor nerfs to area 2 and 3 level layouts (we will likely make a few more adjustments in the coming days)


Additionally, we are hoping to implement mouse movement as an option for tilt controls in the coming weeks to improve the keyboard and mouse experience- we've been meaning to do this for a while, but our schedule has been tight so we haven't been able to get around to it just yet. Steam Achievements are also currently in the works!

Thank you for sticking around, and as always, your feedback is appreciated.

notes.title: Pogo Rogue Major Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have been hard at work over the past few months on our big new update and we are finally ready to release it on Wednesday, October 9th! This update has a ton of new content that we are really excited to share, such as:


 8 new passive items
 4 new active items
 10 brand new "synergy" active items
 4 new weapons
 "Pogosmith" NPC that allows you to upgrade your weapons
 "Traveling Salesman" NPC that sells passive items
 More NPCs!
 6 brand new unlockable characters with unique starting load-outs
 A brand new starting hub/testing grounds to mess around with the different weapons and active items you have discovered
 Several new enemies
 New music and sound effects
 Brand new tutorial
 Lots of bug fixes and polish
 Art improvements
 And more!


We think that you guys will really enjoy these new features and hope that it more than makes up for the lack of recent updates! With that in mind, there are still a couple more things that we’d like to finish before we feel like we can justify removing the “Early Access” title from our page. 

As a result, our official full release date is now currently planned for November 20th! 

However, instead of waiting until then to release our next update, we are planning to roll out the remaining content over several updates in the following weeks, with our final update on November 20th. Since Pogo Rogue was originally made for a university course, our current team has significantly slimmed down and we have since gone our separate ways, working completely remote after our initial launch. Because of this, and because we are keeping our promise of always keeping Pogo Rogue 100% free, we unfortunately cannot guarantee any more updates after the 20th release :( But by then, we hope to be in a state where we feel like no other content needs to be added!

So, what other content is in store for you these next few weeks, you ask?

The two things that we can absolutely, definitively promise are Steam Achievements and 2 new bosses. Our #1 priority will be the Steam achievements, so we hope to get an update out ASAP with them included! We will likely add some more stuff as well, but we’ll keep it a secret for now.

Once again, we are grateful for the support we have received and can’t wait to show you the new stuff we’ve made. If you run into any bugs/issues, please let us know! We have ironed out all of the issues we know about, but our reduced playtesting manpower means we may have missed a few!

See you October 9th!

notes.title: Bug Fixes 5-22
notes.content:
Optimization for the tutorial, boss 1, and boss 2.
 Fixed a bug that allowed the final boss to be defeated before its final phase.
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused tiles not to be drawn.
 Fixed a bug where walls sometimes lose their collision boundaries, causing the player to fall through the map.
Note: due to the nature of this fix, some users may experience a slight decrease in performance. We do not expect that this will impact the gameplay experience, but please report any performance issues that arise.

Thanks for playing Pogo Rogue!

notes.title: 5-12 Pogo Rogue Update
notes.content:
Updates:


 Added shop music
 Freeze now reloads your current weapon on use
 Slime Blaster is now an area 3 item
 Bubble Gun is now an area 2-3 item
 Slightly increased Bubble Gun pop time
 Passive items can no longer be "sold out" in the shop
 "New discovery!" notification when a new item is discovered
 The death screen now shows numbers next to stacked passive items
 UI Display to show the areas each weapon/active item can be found in

Thanks for playing Pogo Rogue, and look forward to more updates and bug fixes soon!
